{{Quote|Sir, the Jedi have reappeared with the prince. They are headed to the surface.|The soldier talking to Riff Tamson|<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''[[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]''' lived on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-wide [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and participated in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], where he fought the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in their [[Coral City/Legends|capital city]]. Some time during the war, he informed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] reappeared with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], after hiding inside a series of caverns, and were heading to the surface.
